questions.question: A new energy drink targets 18-25 males. Propose segmentation, pricing, and promotion strategy

points.text: Segmentation: demographic (18-25, male), psychographic (active, risk-takers), behavioural (gym-goers). Pricing: penetration (GBP 1.50) to gain share quickly. Promotion: social media influencers, gym sponsorships, sampling at events. Place: gyms, convenience stores, online subscription
